name: Bauernstoss
summary: A four-player fixed-partnership German Schafkopf variant where teams bid on trump length and play for card points with special Solos.
rules_text: Bauernstoss is for four players in two fixed opposing teams using a 32-card Skat pack. A=11, 10=10, K=4, Q=3, J=2, 9-7=0, total 120 points. Jacks are permanent trumps, ranked clubs, spades, hearts, diamonds above A-10-K-Q-9-8-7 of the trump suit. Deal 8 cards each clockwise. In clockwise bidding each player with at least one Jack must bid the total size of their intended trump suit including Jacks (2-8), or Solo if holding club Jack, or pass. A higher number beats lower; equal numbers are allowed as 'mit' but ties are broken by the higher lowest trump card, partners may choose between them. Big Solo and Small Solo are bids to win all tricks alone; in Small Solo bidder exchanges one hidden card with partner who then sits out. Play: must follow suit, must trump if void, must overtrump a Jack with higher Jack if possible. Highest trump or highest led suit wins trick. Scoring uses chalk: team with chalk needs 42+ points to keep it and score, opponents need 79+ to take it, 91+ is Schneider and all tricks Schwarz for extra marks.
